data.content: IMPLEMENTATION_REVIEW_BOUNCE: scripts/hive-watcher.cjs waitingOnPeerWorkerIds scans raw .hive-flow/messages/inbox JSON and counts any pending/delivered blocked/ask requiresAck record without verifying the P1 HMAC signature or applying P4 TTL expiry. A forged/tampered or expired message can hold allComplete=false forever even though the store/bridge signed read paths would reject or skip it. Fix by reusing verified message-store semantics in watcher or adding equivalent signature+TTL filtering, with regressions for forged and expired blocked/ask records not counting as waiting while a valid signed pending escalation still counts.
